First, 42 weeks + 7 days = 42 weeks + 1 week = 43 weeks.  
43 weeks = 43 × 7 = 301 days.  
Subtract 301 days from 1793-08-21.  

1793 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400 unless divisible by 100, 1793 not divisible by 4).  
From 1793-08-21 back 21 days → 1793-07-31.  
Remaining 301 − 21 = 280 days to go back.  

280 days earlier from 1793-07-31:  
July has 31 days, so back 30 days → 1793-07-01.  
Remaining 280 − 30 = 250 days.  
June 30 days → 1793-06-01 (back 30 more, 220 left).  
May 31 → 1793-05-01 (back 31, 189 left).  
April 30 → 1793-04-01 (back 30, 159 left).  
March 31 → 1793-03-01 (back 31, 128 left).  
February 28 → 1793-02-01 (back 28, 100 left).  
January 31 → 1793-01-01 (back 31, 69 left).  

Now into 1792 (leap year: divisible by 4, not by 100).  
December 31 → 1792-12-01 (back 31, 38 left).  
November 30 → 1792-11-01 (back 30, 8 left).  
October has 31 days, so 8 days before 1792-11-01 is 1792-10-24.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1792-10-24
